report:
Checkpoint 1 (Reset, V36E): After ENTR, display cleared entirely — PROG, VERB, NOUN, R1, R2, R3 all blank, no lamps.

Checkpoint 2 (Idle loop, V37E 00E): After entry sequence, PROG showed 00, confirmed on read_display (VERB/NOUN blank, registers blank, no lamps).

Checkpoint 3 (Lamp test, V35E): Immediately after ENTR: PROG=88, VERB=88, NOUN=88, R1=" 8    " (still filling). On next read: R1=+88888, R2=+88888, R3=+88888, with lamps_on = [VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, UPLINK ACTY, TEMP, STBY, KEY REL, OPR ERR, RESTART] — i.e. all digit positions showed 8 and all 12 lamps lit. After waiting 10s, lamps_on cleared to [] and PROG returned to 00, though VERB/NOUN/R1-R3 fields still displayed the residual 88/+88888 pattern until overwritten by the next command.

Checkpoint 4 (AGC clock, V16N36E): First reading (t=56.63s sim time): R1=+00002, R2=+00010, R3=+04141. Second reading 9s later (t=65.77s): R1=+00002, R2=+00010, R3=+05041. R3 (100ths of a second) advanced from 04141 to 05041 while R1 (hours) and R2 (minutes) held steady, confirming the clock is counting.

Checkpoint 5 (Gimbal angles, V16N20E): After V34E to terminate the clock monitor and entering V16N20E, ENTR produced and read_display confirmed: R1=+00000, R2=+00000, R3=+00000, no lamps lit, PROG=00.

No OPR ERR lamp appeared at any point requiring RSET recovery.
